Corresponding sources for the exact bundled components. engine/ contains upstream tagged roots and 168 Go module archives, with SHA-256 and Go h1 in manifest.json. rust/ contains original Cargo registry source archives; checksums/versions are in apps/desktop-v2/Cargo.lock and DEPENDENCIES.json. npm/ contains exact runtime package sources with their package.json and original license notices. No engine modifications are applied. Application source is in apps/desktop-v2. Original licenses are in third-party/licenses.
